query:
SELECT 
  f.empresaSlug,
  e.nome AS empresa_nome,
  SUM(CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(15,2))) AS total_cat5,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(15,2)) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS dias_com_cat5,
  MAX(CAST(f.cat5 AS DECIMAL(15,2))) AS maior_cat5
FROM faturamentos f
LEFT JOIN empresas e ON f.empresaSlug = e.slug AND f.tenantId = e.tenantId
WHERE 
  MONTH(f.data) = MONTH(CURDATE())
  AND YEAR(f.data) = YEAR(CURDATE())
GROUP BY f.empresaSlug, e.nome
ORDER BY total_cat5 DESC;
